reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #135 (RUMBO-IA/Rumbo) is titled 'Cashflow execution ledger — 2026-09-13' and its entire body is a business/commercial cashflow ledger: an objective to 'Create near-term online cashflow', a canonical revenue state machine (DISCOVERED -> ... -> PAID), a list of Upwork/Meta commercial application lanes with states like APPLICATION_READY_NOT_SUBMITTED, and a direct-bounty audit. It requests no concrete code change to this repository. Its stated 'Next gate' is 'authenticated submission of the prepared commercial applications' — an external platform action, not a repo engineering task. All 47 comments (author fscfede-beep) are cashflow execution/reconciliation updates (Upwork proposals, Gmail/Calendar sweeps, bounty-source audits); none asks for any implementable change to RUMBO-IA/Rumbo. A repo-wide grep for '#135' and 'execution ledger' finds zero matches in any tracked file, confirming no code artifact is expected. The funding signal attached by admission (GBP 280, amount.usd_value 375.17, source https://github.com/RUMBO-IA/Rumbo/issues/135#issuecomment-5657914406) is itself explicitly retracted in that very comment: 'Gmail reply 1a09d7a59706b617 from Rytis M / QuietForgeTools explicitly clarifies that the GBP 280 amount is a client-paid discovery/test fee payable to QuietForgeTools, and that they are not currently hiring or offering a GBP 280 developer contract' with state QUIETFORGETOOLS_RFQ = CLOSED_NOT_HIRING. So there is neither a live funded engineering task nor a repository code change requested. Classification per policy: documentation/marketing/business deliverable with withdrawn funding -> blocked, checkout left unchanged. No branches/PRs created, no code edited. (For completeness: 27 open PRs exist upstream and none references issue #135, so this is not an already-competing PR case either; it is simply a non-engineering ledger issue.)
